scope: General native-namespace save definitions excluding Maniac/EasyRPG named extensions and private types; recursive raw length/BER checks on original Save03, plus native handler checks of narrow integer fields and execution-state flags. Not a claim of full runtime coverage.
findings: keyinput_variable: legacy raw uint8 vs Maniac full BER; fixed
nine key selector fields: native raw low byte vs generic BER; fixed with legacy format retained
native_state_note: 0x1d/0x1e are ignored by the inspected RPG2003 runtime. Matching wire format does not establish every state-flag semantic; no complete protocol-compatibility claim.
